gallery.description: Tamworth Castle

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (1) - geograph.org.uk - 862765.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (1) - geograph.org.uk - 862765.jpg
gallery.description: A view of  the Castle Grounds  (1) This photograph shows Tamworth town centre's Castle Grounds, where people go especially in the spring and summer to soak up some sunshine and have a chat with friends, whether it be people that are on their lunch break or out for a bit of fresh air. The structure to the left of the photograph with the pointed roof is the Castle grounds bandstand, where performances are held, behind me is the Ankerside Shopping Centre, which has an entrance which allows easy access to the Castle Grounds.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (10) - geograph.org.uk - 867537.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (10) - geograph.org.uk - 867537.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (10) This photograph shows the entrance to Market Street from the Castle Grounds which is accessed by a small bridge that spans the ruins of Tamworth Castles stone Gatehouse that was built circa 1260 -1270, which replaced the previous Norman era Wooden Gateway. Tamworth Castle is to my left out of shot, this path is the same as the one shown in photographs such as 864117  864181  866983
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (2) - geograph.org.uk - 862795.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (2) - geograph.org.uk - 862795.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (2) This photograph shows another view of Tamworth's relaxing Castle Grounds, but from a slightly different angle. This photograph was taken from a balcony which is part of Ankerside Shopping Centre, whose main building was directly behind me.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (4) - geograph.org.uk - 864117.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (4) - geograph.org.uk - 864117.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (4) This photograph shows another part of the Castle Grounds with Tamworth Castle in the background. The path that can be seen going past the square flower box goes upwards towards the steep walkway to Tamworth Castle's entrance. The same pathway goes into the Town centre, it also connects to another pathway which leads to the entrance of Ankerside Shopping centre. The flower beds on the incline next to the bandstand that are in photographs, A view of the Castle Grounds 1 862765 , 2 862795, 3 862815  are behind me.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (5) - geograph.org.uk - 864181.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (5) - geograph.org.uk - 864181.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (5) This photograph shows the Castle Grounds from another angle, the building in the distance to the right hand side is the old Tamworth Council building, which is no longer in use as the Council moved to new premises years ago. The building seen in the centre of the photograph in the distance and the wall on its left hand side are part of the Castle and its grounds.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (6) - geograph.org.uk - 866969.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (6) - geograph.org.uk - 866969.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (6) This photograph shows a view of the Castle Grounds with Tamworth castle, in the back ground, the path in the background going past the Castle is the same as the one in, 864117 and 864181. The path I stood on when I took this photograph is the one that goes past the bandstand, at the top of the inclined stone work flower beds.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (8) - geograph.org.uk - 867503.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (8) - geograph.org.uk - 867503.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (8) This photograph shows a view of the Castle Grounds with Tamworth Castle in the distance, the path in the background going uphill eventually leads to the steep walkway to the Castle entrance, the path also continues past the Castle and into Market Street next to the old Tamworth council building. The inclined stone flower bed and Band stand, as seen in  862765 are behind me.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (9) - geograph.org.uk - 867515.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (9) - geograph.org.uk - 867515.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (9) This photograph shows a path in the Castle Grounds that eventually, if you veer left leads up a steep path to Tamworth Castle, or continues ahead to Market Street this path is the same one as the path in 866983.

gallery.filename: A view of Tamworth Castle (1) - geograph.org.uk - 875337.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of Tamworth Castle (1) - geograph.org.uk - 875337.jpg
gallery.description: A view of Tamworth Castle  (1) This photograph shows a view of Tamworth Castle taken from below in the Castle Grounds, with the inclined Stonework flower beds in the foreground.

gallery.filename: A view of Tamworth Castle (2) - geograph.org.uk - 875354.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of Tamworth Castle (2) - geograph.org.uk - 875354.jpg
gallery.description: A view of Tamworth Castle  (2) This photograph of Tamworth Castle was taken from below in the Castle Grounds.

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (20) - geograph.org.uk - 871289.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (20) - geograph.org.uk - 871289.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (20) This photograph was taken from the location in this photograph 870082  I was standing on the balcony/walkway above the blue door.

gallery.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (34) - geograph.org.uk - 872624.jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of the Castle Grounds (34) - geograph.org.uk - 872624.jpg
gallery.description: A view of the Castle Grounds  (34) This photograph gives a close up view of part of the Castle Grounds, inclined Stonework flower beds, with Tamworth Castle in the background.

gallery.description: 'Herringbone' walling, Tamworth Castle Nikolaus Pevsner (The Buildings of England - Staffordshire) states that this walling is of the late 11C, i.e. soon after the Norman Conquest.
